infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used only for real-time movement analysis during exercises. No image is recorded or sent off device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photo library so you can choose a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The app needs access to your local network to connect to the development server during development.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This app does not use your location. If prompted, you can deny; the app will still work.
